import Mathlib
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Dummit_Foote_exercise_1_6_11 {A B : Type*} [Group A] [Group B] :
  Nonempty (A × B ≃* B × A) := by
  refine ⟨
    { toFun := λ p => (p.2, p.1)
      , invFun := λ q => (q.2, q.1)
      , left_inv := λ p => by cases p; rfl
      , right_inv := λ q => by cases q; rfl
      , map_mul' := λ p₁ p₂ => by
          rcases p₁ with ⟨a₁, b₁⟩
          rcases p₂ with ⟨a₂, b₂⟩
          simp }⟩
